incident.summary: Restricted assessment of suspected shape-shifting infiltration inside partner organizations. The file records unresolved identity doubts and does not name a confirmed list of replaced personnel.
observations: Some access events matched valid credentials used by the wrong person.
Biometric checks available at the time could not resolve the suspicion.
No public alert was issued because the evidence remained incomplete.
incident.conclusion: The infiltration file stays top secret. It is an approved intelligence product and is not eligible for declassified access.
